note: Regional park on the Theodore Reservoir, about 10 km northeast of Theodore, with a boat launch and fish-filleting station, a sand-green golf course, mini golf and disc golf. Two treed loops: Whitesand Drive in the southeast corner and Poplar Lane northwest of the concession. Mostly seasonal: about 17 of its roughly 58 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park, mostly seasonal ~30%). Two loops (Whitesand Drive 21 + group, Poplar Lane 33 + tent); 38 of 54 serviced sites seasonal per the park; Let's Camp sells 13 RV + 4 tent/overflow nightly. C$26.25-31.50 (2026 page), entry C$7/day. Hookups now 50 A/water/sewer (WD5/6/8). Season May 15-Sep 15. WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront (both loops behind 70-120 m of continuous forest). Pin OK.
